title: Meridian Analytics: AMR Market Outlook 2026
text: Outlook edition published 4 March 2026. The warehouse AMR market is forecast to reach $12.4B by 2030, a 14% CAGR from 2025, driven by mid-market adoption and fleet-software attach rates. Downside scenario: $10.9B.
